rows.notes: The cited study is a PRISMA-based systematic review and bibliometric analysis of 85 articles on UAV thermal remote sensing for crop water status (Sections 2-3). It reports no field, laboratory, survey or model data of its own on CWSI-based irrigation timing/zoning or on thermal-multispectral fusion separating heat and nutrient stress; it only tabulates frequencies of crops, sensors, indices and algorithms in the literature and summarises findings of others. Q1 is therefore 'no' and Q2-Q9 follow.
